info.name: Vimas - User (Buyer & Merchant)
info.description: Buyer and merchant-facing APIs for the Vimas e-commerce backend. Run "Register" (username + password, optionally referred_username) to create an account and auto-populate {{token}} and {{refresh_token}} — no email verification is required. Afterwards call "Update Profile" to add first/last name, email, address, country, and phone number. Use "Login (Username)" to sign back in, or "Refresh Token" once the access token expires.
